## Summary

This draft PR establishes a reviewable repository documentation baseline without changing runtime source code.

### Changes
- resolve merge-conflict markers in `README.md`
- resolve merge-conflict markers in `hyperai_phoenix/README.md`
- replace conflicted `.github/copilot-instructions.md` with an evidence-gated workflow
- add `docs/REPOSITORY_BASELINE_AUDIT_20260711.md`

### Why
The default branch currently contains unresolved conflict markers in high-authority documentation. The cleanup separates historical claims from current runtime evidence and reduces the risk that agents treat generated reports or backup trees as live authority.

### Validation
- documentation-only change
- no source code, runtime, deployment, secret, or CI configuration changed
- no auto-merge enabled

### Remaining work
- repository-wide conflict-marker inventory
- active-entrypoint and import-reachability map
- secret scan
- duplicate/generated artifact classification
- CI and focused Codex Security baseline
title: docs: clean repository baseline and remove conflict markers
